items.title: Hits to BREAK a pet
items.how: In a duel, BREAK a friend's Lv 50 Aniimo using only Fire Kick from a Lv 50 Flameruff with 20 BREAK potential and no BREAK buffs: expect about 19 kicks.
details: From the game files: a pet's BREAK bar is about 27,900 at Lv 50 (52,800 at Lv 70), and each hit takes your BREAK × the skill's Might ÷ 10 off it (Flameruff's BREAK 208 × Fire Kick's 7.2 ≈ 1,500).
Any Aniimo works: expected hits ≈ the target's BREAK bar ÷ (your BREAK × the skill's Might ÷ 10). A crit takes off 1.5× as much.
Report the number of hits, both levels, your BREAK stat, the skill, whether any hit crit, and whether it was a duel or the Holo-Battle Simulator.

items.title: Magical skills hit M.DEF
items.how: Hit the same target with a Physical and a Magical skill of similar Might. Pick a target whose P.DEF and M.DEF are far apart (see its Aniimo page).
details: Expected: Magical hits are cut by the target's M.DEF, Physical hits by its P.DEF.
Report both hit numbers, both skills and the target.

items.title: Damage Amp and Damage Reduction cancel
items.how: With +20% Damage Amp up (e.g. Emberpup's Fire Kick after a dodge), hit a target in Helmut's Ballistic Guard (20% Damage Reduction): the hit should match one with neither.
details: The game puts Damage Amp and the target's Damage Reduction in one pot: 1 + 0.2 − 0.2 = ×1. If they multiplied, the hit would be ×0.96.
Report the hits with both effects, with neither, and with each one alone if you can.

items.title: Basic attack bonus multiplies with Damage Amp
items.how: Use Ignitis's Dark Dash (+40% basic attack damage) together with Glacy's Glimmer Shot (+15% Damage Amp): basic attacks should do ×1.61 (1.4 × 1.15), not ×1.55.
details: Report a basic attack's damage with neither, with each, and with both.

items.title: Bonus damage on a BREAKed target
items.how: With Pawney's Ironclad Armament up, hit a target in BREAK, then the same target in BREAK without it: expect 30% more with it.
details: Report the hits and which skill you used.

items.title: Sparkelf's Inspiration: the real number
items.how: Hit with a Fire skill with and without Sparkelf's Inspiration: the game data says +30% Fire damage, the skill text says 15–18%.
details: Report both hits, the skill and Sparkelf's level.

items.title: Hummin's Energized: the real number
items.how: Hummin's BREAK damage: the game data says +2.5% per 1,000 max HP, the trait text says 2%.
details: Compare how much of a target's BREAK bar one Hummin hit removes against the expected BREAK × Might ÷ 10, and note Hummin's max HP.

items.title: Whole-team buffs reach benched Aniimo
items.how: Cast Tromber's Zephyr's Breath or Sparkelf's Inspiration, then switch in an Aniimo that was on the bench: it should have the buff.
details: Report whether the buff icon shows on the switched-in Aniimo and whether its hits are stronger.

items.title: Damage at a level gap
items.how: Hit the same kind of target at your level and about 10 levels above you, with the same skill: note both hits.
details: The game has a level-gap table; which part of it applies to players isn't in the game files you install.
Report your level, both targets' levels and the hit numbers.
